gpcr_rows.claim_boundary: GPCR Phase 3 actual closure requires operator-attached raw hard-decoy ranking rows for every required target plus a verifiable source receipt. Summary metrics or fixture rows do not satisfy actual closure.

boolean_value_policy.local_min_survived: must parse to a boolean value

pocketmd_rows.claim_boundary: PocketMD Lite closure is limited to top-k local refinement rows with local-min survival, contact persistence, H-bond persistence, clash relief, and uncertainty summaries. It does not unlock broad all-atom MD, FEP, long-timescale dynamics, or de novo binding claims.
